Heavy Rains Cause Deaths, Flooding in Uttar Pradesh

Heavy rainfall has led to fatalities and significant flooding across Uttar Pradesh. In Sitapur, two people died due to the rains, while two individuals are reported missing in Ghazipur. The deluge has affected approximately 20,000 people, prompting authorities to deploy boats in Varanasi for rescue and relief operations. In Ghazipur, the local police station was inundated, and streets were submerged.
